headline: Israeli shelling targets outskirts of Mayfadoun and Zawtar ash-Sharqiyah, south Lebanon
dek: The Israeli army intermittently shelled the outskirts of the southern Lebanese towns of Mayfadoun and Zawtar ash-Sharqiyah, per NNA via AJ. No casualty numbers, target, or Israeli statement appear in the liveblog excerpt.
sources: Lebanon's National News Agency, via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Framework agreement vs daily shelling -- is the Lebanon file a ceasefire or an occupation with artillery?

sections.what_happened: The Israeli army intermittently shelled the outskirts of the southern Lebanese towns of Mayfadoun and Zawtar ash-Sharqiyah, per NNA via AJ. No casualty numbers, target, or Israeli statement appear in the liveblog excerpt. This follows the 16:15 Baraachit shelling recorded at 1700-04 and sits alongside the June framework agreement that US officials said would 'restore Lebanon's sovereignty' while Israel continues to occupy parts of the south.

sections.what_disputed: No Israeli statement on these two towns in the reports checked; the June framework agreement is the standing counterweight, not a denial of this incident.
